archetype: Archetype 7: Electric & Neon (Hybrid with Ubuntu/Linux SOC Theme)

core_principles: Authoritative Precision: The interface must feel like a mission-critical Security Operations Center (SOC) console, not a generic SaaS product.
Ubuntu Cybernetic Aesthetic: Deep aubergine-tinted dark backgrounds contrasted with harsh electric neon accents (Red for Threats, Cyan/Blue for Safe/System).
Terminal-Inspired Density: Utilize 'Control Room' grid mechanics. Every pixel is functional. Data is dense, borders are sharp (1px), and typography is highly legible.

rules.numbers: All KPIs, metric counts, and IP addresses MUST use the mono font (JetBrains Mono).

spacing_and_layout.mode: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID

grid_system.base: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 md:gap-6

spacing_and_layout.padding_rules: Card internals should use p-5 or p-6. Terminal windows should use tight padding (p-4).

surfaces_and_micro_themes.cards: Flat background (surface_card), 1px solid border (border-default), rounded-none or max rounded-md. NO soft shadows. Use 'Grid Borders' tech look.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.threat_cards: Same as default cards, but with border-t-2 or border-l-2 using threat_red.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.terminal_panels: Deepest black (surface_terminal), border border-active, font-mono. Use for Live Attack Simulator and Logs.

buttons.primary: bg-accent-safe_blue text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wide hover:bg-white transition-colors rounded-sm px-6 py-2
buttons.destructive: bg-accent-threat_red/10 border border-accent-threat_red text-accent-threat_red hover:bg-accent-threat_red hover:text-white transition-colors rounded-sm px-4 py-2

surfaces_and_micro_themes.inputs: bg-surface_terminal border border-borders-default focus:border-accent-safe_blue text-text-primary placeholder:text-text-muted rounded-sm px-3 py-2

components.charts: Use Recharts. Crucial: Set chart grid lines to subtle stroke (#2A2536). Remove axis lines, keep tick labels in font-mono text-xs.
components.tables: Dense. Use Shadcn Table. hover:bg-white/5 for rows. Threat rows must feature a left-accent border in red. IP addresses in font-mono.
components.login_screen: Split view. Left: Sharp, brutalist login form using terminal motifs. Right: Full bleed neon data background image with a dark overlay (bg-black/60).
components.attack_simulator: Render as a faux command-line interface. Action buttons (Fire SQLi, XSS) should look like terminal scripts. Output area should auto-scroll like live logs.
components.file_upload: Dashed border (border-dashed border-borders-active). On drag over, border turns safe_blue with a slight safe_blue_glow background.

animations.charts: Framer Motion layout animations for data changes. Subtle pulse on live active threats.
animations.alerts: New threats entering the table should flash bg-accent-threat_red/20 before settling.
animations.hover_states: -translate-y-[1px] with a subtle colored drop-shadow (e.g., shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(0,212,255,0.1)]) on interactive cards.

login_background.description: Abstract neon red and blue lines representing network data flows. To be used as the right-side cover image on the Admin Login page.

shield_icon.description: Cybersecurity cubes abstract background. Can be used for header branding or simulator panel backgrounds at 10% opacity.
shield_icon.usage: Subtle textured background for the Live Attack Simulator or Rules page.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements, forms, and major metric displays MUST include data-testid. Examples: data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='metric-blocked-requests', data-testid='sim-sqli-btn'.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Tailwind config explicitly mapping the colors defined here. E.g., background-app -> bg-background, text-primary -> text-foreground.
2. For Shadcn UI components, override the default border radii to be extremely small (0px to 4px max) to maintain the technical, sharp 'Terminal' look.
3. Dashboard Grid: Use CSS Grid explicitly. Do not rely solely on Flexbox for the main dashboard skeleton.
4. Navigation should be a vertical sidebar or a dense top-bar with a heavy, solid background (not transparent) to anchor the UI.
5. Font loading: Ensure Chivo, IBM Plex Sans, and JetBrains Mono are loaded via Google Fonts or standard imports.
